items.stem: Which TWO are good practices in a basic financial model? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Keep assumptions in labelled input cells
options.rationale: Correct: referenced assumptions make the model maintainable.

options.text: Reference assumptions rather than hard-coding them in formulas
options.rationale: Correct: a single referenced input updates everywhere at once.

Sanity checks are essential before relying on a model.
